record.body_digest: SHA256 of exact body; integrity only, not authority

binding: Independent intended device/correlation and non-reused live connection generation; monotonic nonzero transfer ID per direction/connection, deny exhaustion. Incoming bytes cannot choose authority or approved context.
reassembly: One admitted record per direction; fixed 494-byte receive buffer; arbitrary order, exact duplicates produce no second delivery, conflicting same-transfer bytes close and wipe; zero final padding; no allocation from declared length.
custody: phone_custody body is exact original installation-report signed-content SHA25632; correlation is delivery UUID; device is report target. Only typed durable phone custody plus authenticated expected carrier may release matching retained evidence. Decoding/ATT acceptance is insufficient.
security: UntrustedRecord only. Existing configured factory/ownership-control signature/context verification, monotonic native installation and readback remain mandatory. No private key/QR type or implicit Ready/Start. Wire body hash is distinct from COSE signed-content identity.
deadlines: No scheduler, timeout number or automatic retry policy selected here. Runtime caller must retain the original measured task deadline, close on cancel/disconnect/expiry, reject late generations and settle borrowed TX memory. Unmeasured numerical freeze remains open.
nearby_setup: Complete original setup records and evidence over LINK-CORE Bluetooth, then fresh policy/peer/boot-bound first-channel preparation and authenticated bidirectional LoRa validation. The latter needs an explicit role/carrier profile; existing field v2 is unchanged.
recovery: Installed permissions/evidence survive failed radio validation; retry unfinished stage. Remote reboot retains a separate fresh radio-only authentication path; no old boot traffic-key reuse.
limits: Candidate record/framing foundation only. Live BLE service/role coexistence, admission/DoS/replay manager, async TX/cancellation/deadline owner, CORE signer/flash, native phone field provider, key adoption and LoRa probes are not implemented.
